# Generated by gen_p05.py - do not edit by hand.
source React 19.3.1 on jsdom 30.1.3 for the dumps; the unit formula for the idle lines; a model in tools/gen_p05.py for the ops lines
seed 1
compare records idle=units dump=n node=depth,label,tag,props text=depth,value title=value ops=insert,move,remove
explain node:props=R5 text:value=R5
requirement R1 while units run the container stays empty: a dump after a period that leaves work undone shows no node
requirement R2 the period that runs the last unit also commits: a dump right after it shows the whole tree
requirement R3 the commit adds no unit and no timeRemaining() read: idle k still reports min(k, units left), then 0
requirement R4 every node is inserted once, by the commit: ops insert move remove is 0 0 0 while work is pending, N 0 0 in the period of the last unit (N = elements + text nodes), and 0 0 0 after that
requirement R5 the committed tree has the right shape: nesting, sibling order, props and text
requirement E2E whole scenarios: periods, dumps and ops mixed
